tasks.title: Nmap DNS Scripts
tasks.description: Fingerprint the DNS server and run default enumeration scripts. Check both TCP and UDP — zone transfers happen over TCP even though normal lookups use UDP.

tasks.title: Attempt a Zone Transfer (AXFR)
tasks.description: The single highest-value DNS misconfiguration to check for: if AXFR is allowed to any client, you get the entire zone file in one shot — every hostname, subdomain, and often internal IP the org has.

tasks.title: Automated Enumeration (dnsrecon)
tasks.description: Runs zone transfer attempts, standard record lookups, and (optionally) subdomain brute-forcing in one pass.

tasks.title: Map AD Roles via SRV Records
tasks.description: Active Directory registers itself in DNS with SRV records that reveal which hosts are Domain Controllers, Global Catalogs, and PDC emulators — useful for finding every DC in a multi-DC domain without a single credential.

tasks.title: Reverse Lookup & Full Domain Record Dump
tasks.description: Pull every A/PTR record the DC's DNS zone holds — often reveals internal hostnames for hosts that don't otherwise announce themselves on the network you can see.
